title: サクラバクシンオー登場！

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sakura Bakushin O, an Umamusume who is basically the concept of class representative incarnate. With a burning passion to become an exemplary figure to all, she sets off to challenge the Twinkle Series!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: To become a leading example for her classmates, her mission is to win every single G1 race. However, running in every single race won't be realistic.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After reproaching her some, Sakura Bakushin O changes her gears towards a common path for many Umamusume, the Classics. Eyes set on the "Bakushin Road," she runs full steam ahead!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Despite her talent for sprinting, Sakura Bakushin O wants to follow a different path. It'll be tough for me to figure out how to best make use of her skills.
